panels.title: Task Success Rate by Agent (last 7 days)

targets.rawSql: SELECT agent_id, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type='task.task_completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type='task.task_failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed FROM activity_events WHERE category='task' AND agent_id IS NOT NULL AND timestamp > datetime('now', '-7 days') GROUP BY agent_id ORDER BY completed DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT agent_id, COUNT(*) AS total_events, SUM(CASE WHEN severity='error' OR severity='critical' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errors FROM activity_events WHERE agent_id IS NOT NULL AND timestamp > datetime('now', '-24 hours') GROUP BY agent_id ORDER BY total_events DESC

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:00:00Z', timestamp) AS time, agent_id, COUNT(*) AS events FROM activity_events WHERE agent_id IS NOT NULL AND timestamp > datetime('now', '-24 hours') GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H', timestamp), agent_id ORDER BY time
